### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan for the Faded Archive Tee Launch

| Day | Hook / Theme | Caption Idea | Visual Prompt | CTA |
|-----|--------------|--------------|---------------|-----|
| 1 | **Launch Teaser** | “Something fresh is dropping 🎉 Stay tuned for the reveal of our brand‑new tee collection. #FadedArchive” | Black background with the shop’s logo split in half, one half white, the other half black. | “Comment 👀 if you’re ready to hit the shelves!” |
| 2 | **Behind‑the‑Scenes** | “From design to shirt—here’s a sneak‑peek of our first tee in production. Quality you can see, vibes you can feel.” | Video of the printing machine at work, zoom on the design. | “Tag a friend who loves limited‑edition tees!” |
| 3 | **Style Inspiration** | “Peel back the past, wear the future. Trusted to your wardrobe, this tee tells a story.” | Flat lay of the tee next to vintage props (band tee, old journal). | “Save 👌 to plan your outfit.” |
| 4 | **Customer Spotlight** | “Meet Jamie—his favorite Faded Archive tee rocks on him. What’s your story?” | Photo of a customer wearing the tee (or an illustrated avatar). | “Drop a pic of you wearing your tee in the comments!” |
| 5 | **Launch Day & Offer** | “Today’s the day: Faded Archive tees are live! Limited stock—grab yours before they’re gone.” | Product shot with a countdown timer overlay. | “Tap the link in bio to shop now. Use code LAUNCH5 for 5% off!” |

### eBay UK Fees for Clothing (Generic Overview)

| Fee Type | Typical Rate | What It Covers |
|----------|--------------|----------------|
| **Insertion (Listing) Fee** | Free up to 50 listings a month; thereafter £0.50 per listing | Basic listing permission |
| **Final Value Fee** | 15 % of the **sale price** (₹ 51‑£50) or £0.90 (over £50) | Plus a £1.30 flat fee for every item sold |


**Quick Tip:** Check your sellers‑hub for any promotions that reduce or waive final‑value fees.
